## HL · Listening post: Monday report (Lesson 5.3)
Mondays 08:00. Code counts (by sentiment, topic and source, compared with last week; spam excluded and the exclusion reported). AI only explains: three fixes, each backed by real quotes. Email to Tolu plus a Telegram summary.

Credentials: Google Sheets; OpenAI; Gmail; Telegram.
Placeholders: YOUR_SHEET_ID, YOUR_MODEL, YOUR_TOLU_EMAIL, YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

messageValues.message: You help a small business owner decide what to fix this week. Write exactly three fixes, most frequent first. For each: a short title, the number of mentions it covers, and one quote copied exactly from the comments given. Do not calculate percentages or totals; do not invent quotes. Plain text, one line per fix.
